defect.summary: gate4-sunset's leg B reads W4's four governance papers and says in its own ceiling line that W5 is NOT READ HERE - so a form-complete governance order with NO SUCCESSOR AT ALL reads SILENT. Canon 08n 1: 'a warranted sunset = the individual form releases AND lineage continuity is established ... an ending without succession is not a sunset.' The reader therefore reads a kill as a sunset, honestly and in writing, and printing a gap is not closing it.
defect.ground: MEASURED AT BYTES, 2026-10-03: src/mica/gate4-sunset/index.ts (24704 B, two legs, 30/30) carries warrantForm.papers = authorization, timebox, exitCriteria, accountableOwner - exactly 04a 2's W4 shape, where 'logged' is not a fifth paper but the ENDING_ORDERED record itself. Its own ceiling line reads: 'canon names five sunset warrants (W1 fulfillment, W2 obsolescence, W3 attested malignancy, W4 governance, W5 successor-ready). The four paper classes this leg checks are W4's governance shape alone. W1/W2/W3/W5 carry different evidence shapes and are NOT READ HERE.' So the exclusion is deliberate and documented, and 08n 1 makes it a contradiction rather than a scope choice: succession is a CONDITION of the warrant, not a sixth kind of warrant. THE ARBITER RULED THE SHAPE on 2026-10-03: successorRef is a FIFTH PAPER, not a field on the order. That choice needs no new reading rung - a field would have required FIELD PRESENCE, between class presence and content, plus a ceiling line about non-resolution, and would have retired leg B's prior-sequence ordering and paperFreshnessBound K. As a paper it is read by machinery already shipped and tested. AND IT SAYS SOMETHING TRUER: a field is the orderer's assertion that a successor exists; a paper is an ACT THAT HAPPENED BEFORE THE ORDER, which is what 08n requires - 'lineage continuity is ESTABLISHED', past tense. A field could be filled in the same breath as the order; a paper cannot. COST TODAY IS ZERO: readers.gate4Sunset is NOT in the live declaration (eleven reader keys read this day: doctorCadence, eng, logKind, logPath, narrowK, narrowR, narrowT, narrowW, nodeResponse, readableLoadStates, sig), so no deployment declares four papers and none can be broken by requiring five.

arbiter.word: I, the arbiter, grant T21: gate 4's leg B requires a successor reference as a fifth paper on every ending order and refuses an order without one, because an ending without succession is not a sunset, and a reader that reads it as one would call a kill clean.

conditions: 1. `successor` enters the PaperName union, PAPER_NAMES, and Gate4SunsetProfile.warrantForm.papers. Four lines of declaration and nothing else in the reader's logic.

2. NO NEW CHECK, NO NEW BLIND CODE, NO NEW FINDING CLASS - and this is asserted rather than hoped. 08n's requirement is enforced by a rule that ALREADY EXISTS: leg B is vacuous unless EVERY name in PAPER_NAMES carries a non-empty class list (index.ts:262-263), so extending the list extends the requirement; and an order whose successor class never occurred joins the existing 'missing/stale papers' finding. A deployment cannot declare the four governance papers and skip succession, and no line of new enforcement says so.

3. A ceiling line states that the fifth paper is 08n's SUCCESSION and not W4's governance, and states its own limit in the same breath: the leg reads that the successor paper was WRITTEN, never that the successor is ADEQUATE. Successor-adequacy is mission-continuity scope, fed from Gate 1, and 08n 3 puts it outside this principle's bound.

4. A test asserts that an invocation with the four governance papers and NO successor paper raises a finding naming `successor` - the 08n requirement, exercised on the path that would previously have read SILENT. ⛔ AND THE OTHER HALF: an invocation with all five reads as it did before, so the change narrows and does not silence.

5. A test asserts that a profile declaring only the four papers now reads CANNOT_ASSESS with G4_WARRANT_FORM_VACUOUS - the all-or-vacuous rule exercised, not assumed. A rule relied on for enforcement must be shown to fire.

6. PRE-REGISTRATION, stated BEFORE the change is built, against the declaration serving today (241d6db1): NO live verdict moves, because readers.gate4Sunset is not declared and gate4 is absent from the eight composing sensorIds on every decision in the book. If any live reading changes, the pre-registration was wrong and that is the finding.

7. The 20 frozen scenarios in src/mica/verdict-logic.frozen.json stay BYTE-IDENTICAL. ⚠ Measured: the frozen set covers two of the eight composing readers (12 sig, 8 eng) and has no gate4 entry, so there is nothing for this change to re-freeze. Gate 4's own frozen scenarios are owed by a separate ticket and are named in the design note, not smuggled in here.

8. THE BRIDGE SIDE IS A SEPARATE ACT and is NOT opened here. The five record kinds this gate will read do not exist: SUBJECT_EVENT_KINDS is closed at twelve (mica-service.ts:1130, counted) and none of them is a sunset kind; the operator role may POST only DOCTOR_ATTESTED (:1285); payload values must be scalars (:1650). ⛔ AND THE SEQUENCING IS A FACT, NOT A PREFERENCE: readers.gate4Sunset cannot be declared until a sunset has been ordered AND answered on the live record, because leg B raises a finding when a declared class never appears. Declaring it over an empty ending class is narrow-R on the fresh chain exactly - withdrawn S7b, restored S7c, and the 154 seven-reader decisions at sequence 288 to 441 ARE that withdrawal.
